_doc: NPC enchant rules per item. position = card slot the enchant occupies (4 = last, then 3, 2). options = allowed enchant item IDs (null = any enchant). Items not listed fall back to `default`. Maintained by hand from Gnjoy pages / in-game screenshots — the client has no enchant data. `randomOptions` = rows of range-based random options (Tengu B.Scroll, BP Shadow boxes): the user types the rolled value; each row stores {key, value} and is summed like a bonus.
